question: How is the final principle related to the world of difference?
premises: The principle appearing as final in the seventeenth section is determined to be the unsurpassed state of Shiva for those desiring attainment.
All that is taught here stands in apparent opposition within the bliss of the world.
This entire expansion remains established through the life of difference.
inference: The unsurpassed Shiva-state is taught as final even while the whole differentiated expansion persists as its apparent opposite.
plain_english: Thus the principle that appears as the final one in the seventeenth section is determined to be the unsurpassed state of Shiva for those who seek attainment. All that has been taught here appears opposed within worldly bliss, because this entire expansion stands animated by difference.
